criteria_document: IMD Heatwave Warnings & Guidelines for Coastal & Island Stations

coastal_station_criteria.definition: For coastal stations, heatwave is declared when maximum temperature departure is 4.5°C or more from normal, provided actual maximum temperature is 37°C or more.

plains_criteria.definition: Heatwave is considered when maximum temperature of a station reaches at least 40°C or more for plains and at least 30°C for hilly regions.

severity_levels.heatwave: Departure from normal is 4.5°C to 6.4°C or actual max temp >= 45°C
severity_levels.severe_heatwave: Departure from normal is > 6.4°C or actual max temp >= 47°C

waterflow_scenario_mapping.description: Engineered sensitivity curve mapping IMD coastal alerts to informal settlement domestic hydration and relief tanker surge factor.
